spans.s: आर्ष (I) a. (f. र्षी) 1. Relating or belonging to a Ṛshi; 2. Vedic, (op. to लौकिक or classical), e.g. आर्षः प्रयोगः.

आर्ष (II) m. One of the eight forms of marriage; in it the father of the bride receives one pair of kine from the bride-groom (आदायार्षस्तु गोद्वयम् Yaj.i.59); for the names of the eight forms, see आसुर.
आर्ष (III) n. The holy text, i.e. the Vedas.
अर्शस a. (f. सा) Suffering from piles.
अर्शस a. (f. सा) Suffering from piles.
अर्शोघ्न m. A plant called Sūraṇa; so called because it is supposed to cure piles.
आर्ष (I) a. (f. र्षी) 1. Relating or belonging to a Ṛshi; 2. Vedic, (op. to लौकिक or classical), e.g. आर्षः प्रयोगः.
आर्षभ्य m. A steer fit to be let loose.
आर्षेय a. (f. या) 1. Relating or belonging to a Ṛshi; 2. venerable, respectable.
आर्षेय a. (f. या) 1. Relating or belonging to a Ṛshi; 2. venerable, respectable.
